citation: OpenET development team. SSEBop Earth Engine model implementation and references. https://github.com/Open-ET/openet-ssebop
description: OpenET SSEBop is the OpenET team's Earth Engine implementation of the Operational Simplified Surface Energy Balance model. It contains Python routines that estimate daily actual evapotranspiration from land-surface temperature, air-temperature information and reference evapotranspiration. The principal output is an image of the reference-ET fraction, multiplied by reference ET to obtain actual water loss. Coverage and spatial detail follow the selected Landsat Collection 2 image and ancillary data; estimates represent daily conditions. Apache-2.0 source and example notebooks are free, while Earth Engine has separate account and service terms. A limitation is that the simplified model prescribes hot and cold bounds instead of solving every energy-balance term explicitly. The README also marks the implementation as unsupported development code. It supports irrigation and water-balance simulations. AIWUM (model-usgs-aiwum-2-aquaculture-irrigation-water-use-model) uses related SSEBop data, but does not cover this separate model implementation.
